notes: Chunk 102 (25 candidates): 2 program-list, 0 single-record, 23 not-a-list. Both list pages are dissertation lists without placements. (1) The CityU Scholars theses page of the Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management is paginated (155 doctoral theses, 8 pages of 20; the saved capture holds only page 1, award dates 7 May 2021 back to 3 Sep 2019) and gives author surname with initials, award date and supervisors; systems engineering/engineering management is within scope but the list mixes operations-type topics (appointment scheduling, supply chain, warranties, simulation optimization) with construction safety, structural health monitoring and software testing, so the area needs classifying per person. (2) The Ecole Polytechnique i3-CRG (Centre de Recherche en Gestion, Management Research Center) completed-PhD-theses page is page 1 of 5 and shows five 2020 defenses with full names, defense dates and titles; later pages were not captured. The CityU single-person thesis record (Xiaoling Zhong, doctoral thesis 18 Aug 2017 on prospect theory in bond and stock markets) was kept as not-a-list under the finance rule because the page names no department; an integrator who counts College of Business finance theses could treat it as a single-record degree-completion fact (no placement stated). The Chaire PSA page lists five named mechanical-engineering theses (2011-2017) and the Polytechnique news item names two 2019 PhDs (applied mathematics, economics) with their postdoc positions; both kept as not-a-list under the department rule. Six IIT Madras pages are electrical-engineering admission shortlists or admitted-applicant lists, not graduates. Institutions by host were kept for all entries; none plainly belongs to another institution.
